name: wise-hirehop-proposal-platform
purpose: Wise internal HireHop enhancement package for proposal authoring, document preview, native item workflow helpers, capacity tracking, and QTC renderer alignment.

activeScripts.role: Document preview panel used by power users and by the page editor preview dock.
Small native-popup helper for repetitive line item selection actions.
Shared WisePageMeta and editor/template identifier contract consumed by the section builder and aligned to the QTC renderer.
Shared proposal page/layout catalogue consumed by the section builder.
Shared HireHop selectors, endpoint paths, depot rules, retry timings, search helpers, and tree item prefixes consumed by the section builder and capacity tracker.
Main proposal page editor and HireHop authoring layer.
Full-page Wise capacity timeline using project-level custom fields, date-range filtering, and Wise status controls.

referenceFiles.role: Copy of the renderer already deployed in HireHop; useful locally for alignment checks.

legacyFiles.role: V1 concept editor superseded by sectionbuilder2.
Older section builder snapshot retained as a manual rollback reference.
